A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-hothechomedlab-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the 2018 E card. The whole card is drawn again at 1039 × 745 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of “E”.

The whole of the 2018 E card and the whole of the D-E1 card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
